filter.urlRule: exact lowercase ASCII [a-z]+; reject rather than normalize punctuation or Unicode. Hyphens are URL-safe but deliberately excluded to avoid ambiguity with hyphen word delimiters.
filter.warning: Preliminary lexical screen only. No exhaustive semantic, cultural, multilingual, homophone, or cross-word phrase safety guarantee; manual allowlist review needed.
